history.zh: 2026-10-15，整合 I3b（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（Becoming.Granularity 的“配方”）。配方在所到达的配置处选择：一个动作、在路径所在处的检验、先后两配方或二者之一（Recipe、Recipe.Leads）；其路径是框架的路径，检验与选择不加动作（Recipe.Leads.trace）。配方是否通向某检验成立之处，恰是有限多个分支检验之一成立，不加前提（Recipe.leads_iff_afterAny），所以同测的配置对每个配方问题回答相同（SameBranchingTests.leads_iff）。把配方读作单一检验（经否定与合取），在检验已定处精确（Recipe.holds_after）；对每个框架都精确，恰是排中律（Recipe.holds_after_iff_em）：外围的 holds_either 用经典推理，而这一用法不能去掉。在前段使检验在其通向的每个配置保持之处，先检验即后检验（Recipe.branch_earlier_iff）。桥接：外围的程序即核心的配方（Recipe.ofProgram、Recipe.leads_ofProgram），diamond 即 Recipe.after（Recipe.toTest_after）；diamond_correct 在检验已定处成立（diamond_correct_of_decided），对每个模型恰是排中律（diamond_correct_iff_em）；以 em 为具名假设，compile_correct、finite_program_endpoints、guarded_history_matches 逐字成立；word_program_exact、execution_has_native_trace、branch_executes、guard_hoisting_sound 不加假设。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 15 October 2026, integration I3b (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (the recipes of Becoming.Granularity). A recipe chooses at the configuration reached: one move, a test where the course stands, one recipe after another, or either of two (Recipe, Recipe.Leads); its courses are courses of the frame, and tests and choices add no move (Recipe.Leads.trace). Whether a recipe leads to where a test holds is exactly one of finitely many branching tests holding, with no premise (Recipe.leads_iff_afterAny), so configurations passing the same tests answer every recipe question alike (SameBranchingTests.leads_iff). Read as one test, through negation and conjunction, a recipe is exact where the tests are decided (Recipe.holds_after); exact for every frame, it is exactly excluded middle (Recipe.holds_after_iff_em): the periphery’s holds_either reasons classically, and that use cannot be dropped. Testing before a prefix is testing after it where the prefix keeps the test at every configuration it leads to (Recipe.branch_earlier_iff). In the bridge, the periphery’s programs are the core’s recipes (Recipe.ofProgram, Recipe.leads_ofProgram) and diamond is Recipe.after (Recipe.toTest_after); diamond_correct holds where the tests are decided (diamond_correct_of_decided) and, for every model, is exactly excluded middle (diamond_correct_iff_em); with em named, compile_correct, finite_program_endpoints and guarded_history_matches hold as stated; word_program_exact, execution_has_native_trace, branch_executes and guard_hoisting_sound need nothing. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope.

title.zh: 随到达条件分支的有限展开与问答恢复
title.en: Finite reached-condition branching and question recovery

claim.zh: 有限判断、分支、顺序及提前结束的程序问题精确编译为原生问题。完整翻译问答一致且接收侧有限分支时，不同原生程序的有限宏历史有同测终点的对应。原固定词精确嵌入；前段的每个端点保持判断时，提前判断保真。
claim.en: Finite guarded, sequential and choice program questions compile exactly to native questions. Complete translated-answer agreement and receiving-side finite branching match finite macro histories over different native programs, preserving endpoint answers. Fixed words embed exactly; moving a guard earlier is sound if every prefix endpoint preserves it.

hypotheses.zh: 给定有限无循环Program语法、原生过程、原子问题对应和到达位置上的guard语义。
hypotheses.en: Supplied finite loop-free Program syntax, native processes, atomic-question correspondence and guards interpreted at reached positions.

hypotheses.zh: 跨程序匹配需初始完整翻译问答一致及接收侧ImageFinite；提前判断的充分条件是全部前段结果保持该判断。
hypotheses.en: Cross-program matching requires complete initial translated-answer agreement and receiving-side ImageFinite; safe early testing requires guard preservation at all prefix endpoints.

correspondence.zh: 每个执行投到同一过程的原生路径。guard和管理步骤在语义中不另计物理事件，不独自给出传感、学习或资源实施。
correspondence.en: Every execution projects to a native path in the same process. Guards and administrative steps contribute no represented physical events and do not establish sensing, learning or resource implementation.

detail.zh: 用后继匹配恢复条件程序的边界历史。
detail.en: Use successor matching to recover guarded-program boundary histories.

input.zh: program_image_finite 供给有限端点；guarded_history_matches 逐步使用同测恢复。
input.en: program_image_finite supplies finite endpoints; guarded_history_matches uses answer recovery stepwise.

conditions.zh: 完整翻译问答一致与接收侧有限性，不推出全部中间位置对应。
conditions.en: Complete translated-answer agreement and receiving-side finiteness; no general internal-position matching.

detail.zh: word_program_exact 将固定有限词嵌入新语法；通用编译被推广，不把历史包装另计独立发现。
detail.en: word_program_exact embeds fixed finite words into the new grammar; generic compilation is extended, without recounting historical wrappers as discoveries.

limitations.zh: 不涵盖无界循环、实际判断取得、概率、部署终止或任意内部语法的中间位置互译；提前判断条件只证明充分性。
limitations.en: Does not cover unbounded loops, actual guard acquisition, probabilities, deployment termination or internal-position translation across arbitrary syntax; the early-testing condition is sufficient only.

detail.zh: 同一过程形成前后canFinish改变；提前测试与到达后测试有不同结果。
detail.en: The same process changes canFinish through formation; testing early and after arrival yields different outcomes.
